tools.name: db_set_profile
tools.description: Set the sticky session connection profile to "dev" or "qa" (or "default"). Call when the user says dbprofile=dev, dbprofile=qa, use Dev DB, switch to QA, etc. Later tools reuse this profile automatically — no host/password in chat. Credentials are loaded from DBEAVER_DEV_* / DBEAVER_QA_* (or PG_DEV_* / PG_QA_*) in mcp.json.

verify.description: If true (default), run SELECT 1 against the new profile

tools.name: db_status
tools.description: Show current sticky PostgreSQL profile, host, database, write mode, and a live SELECT 1 health check. Optional profile arg for a one-shot check without changing the sticky session.

database.description: Optional database override for the health check

profile.description: Connection profile: "dev" | "qa" | "default". Uses credentials from mcp.json (DBEAVER_DEV_* / DBEAVER_QA_* or PG_DEV_* / PG_QA_*). Omit to use the sticky session profile from db_set_profile / DBEAVER_PROFILE.

tools.name: db_list_databases
tools.description: List databases on the active profile server (or optional one-shot profile=dev|qa).

profile.description: Connection profile: "dev" | "qa" | "default". Uses credentials from mcp.json (DBEAVER_DEV_* / DBEAVER_QA_* or PG_DEV_* / PG_QA_*). Omit to use the sticky session profile from db_set_profile / DBEAVER_PROFILE.

tools.name: db_list_schemas
tools.description: List non-system schemas. Optional database and/or profile (dev|qa) override.

profile.description: Connection profile: "dev" | "qa" | "default". Uses credentials from mcp.json (DBEAVER_DEV_* / DBEAVER_QA_* or PG_DEV_* / PG_QA_*). Omit to use the sticky session profile from db_set_profile / DBEAVER_PROFILE.

tools.name: db_list_tables
tools.description: List tables/views for a schema (default public). Optional database and/or profile override.

profile.description: Connection profile: "dev" | "qa" | "default". Uses credentials from mcp.json (DBEAVER_DEV_* / DBEAVER_QA_* or PG_DEV_* / PG_QA_*). Omit to use the sticky session profile from db_set_profile / DBEAVER_PROFILE.

tools.name: db_describe_table
tools.description: Describe columns for a table or view. Optional schema, database, and/or profile override.

profile.description: Connection profile: "dev" | "qa" | "default". Uses credentials from mcp.json (DBEAVER_DEV_* / DBEAVER_QA_* or PG_DEV_* / PG_QA_*). Omit to use the sticky session profile from db_set_profile / DBEAVER_PROFILE.

tools.name: db_query
tools.description: Run SQL against the sticky session profile (or optional profile=dev|qa for one call). Read-only by default. Optional database name and maxRows. Do not ask the user for connection host/password — use profiles.

maxRows.description: Max rows to return (default from DBEAVER_QUERY_MAX_ROWS / PG_MAX_ROWS)

profile.description: Connection profile: "dev" | "qa" | "default". Uses credentials from mcp.json (DBEAVER_DEV_* / DBEAVER_QA_* or PG_DEV_* / PG_QA_*). Omit to use the sticky session profile from db_set_profile / DBEAVER_PROFILE.
